1.

Rest in the home with the Lord, Far from conflict and strife, Already in hope it imparts To the believing heart peace.

C.

Jesus, with Thee is found rest, Eternal sabbath repose; Ah, soon after the storm and the conflict We shall with Thee dwell.

2.

The angel with the sword is gone, Open stands Eden’s gate, The eye, though tears may flow, Yet sees that fair place.

3.

Over the suffering heart Shines the bright day, Permitting the tested child To be satisfied with God’s good pleasure.

4.

The ear amid a thousand voices Yet hears a gentle sound, Hears how the Spirit proclaims Sweet things concerning God.

5.

And of the heavenly treasures Already Thou dost here give us, Giving to hungry souls Daily more and more. Jesus, with Thee, etc.
